text:
Dana Kim: Quick flag — the social launch post drove a big session spike but no corresponding lift in qualified leads. sessions +72% week-over-week, qleads flat. dashboard: https://redwood.app/dashboards/launch-performance :thinking_face:
marketing-bot: ALERT: channel conversion anomaly detected for campaign 'launch-apr-social' (conversion rate drop 48% vs baseline). Investigate UTM drift & form errors: https://redwood.app/alerts/3021
Rory Blake: Is the dashboard using conversions = webinar_reg or conversions = qualified_demo? the metric matters for the deck.
Dana Kim: the weekly deck uses "qualified_lead" (QLead) for performance. for quick checks i'm looking at webinar_reg too.
Maya Alvarez: quick SQL to compare sources (ran on the analytics read replica):
```
SELECT source, count(*) as leads
FROM analytics.marketing_leads
WHERE created_at >= '2026-04-10'
AND created_at < '2026-04-17'
GROUP BY source
ORDER BY leads DESC;
```
Result snippet: social_twitter 1,842, organic_newsletter 512, paid_search 398, launch_email 47. last week launch_email was 189.
Omar Rahman: That drop is consistent with an iframe form change we pushed last Friday for the AB copy test. Variant B replaced `id=signup` with `id=signup_v3`. Tracking listener looks for `signup`. can someone confirm the frontend diff?
Maya Alvarez: I also pulled GA4 events; GA4 shows 162 conversions attributed to launch_email in the same window. ETL ingestion shows 47. big mismatch. looks like some events lost on ingest.
Rory Blake: sounds like a classic GTM/UTM + listener mismatch. @Omar can you check the commit and revert if necessary?
Omar Rahman: found the PR: https://github.com/redwood/marketing/pull/517 - changed form id in variant B. I'll push a hotfix to add a `data-track` attribute and update the listener to be resilient.
Dana Kim: we need two things: 1) a backfill to recover lost leads, 2) re-run the weekly KPI snapshot with both last_touch and multi_touch attribution to see how messaging percent changes.
marketing-bot: BACKFILL scheduled: job 1299 queued by Maya Alvarez (targets 2026-04-10 -> 2026-04-12). Status: queued.
Maya Alvarez: I'll run the ingestion backfill and also compare GA4 event raw payloads to our event logs to see where fields dropped.
Rory Blake: For the deck, I'll include two slides: one with last_touch and one with multi_touch, and a short appendix listing data corrections. don't change messaging until Monday review.
Omar Rahman: Hotfix PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/marketing/pull/519 - adds `data-track` and graceful fallback. pushing to prod in 30m.
Dana Kim: Plan: Omar deploys hotfix (owner), Maya runs backfill & reconciles GA4 vs ingestion (owner), Rory updates deck and flags slide for Monday KPI review (owner). If backfill finds >10% delta we'll delay messaging.
marketing-bot: BACKFILL job 1299 started. ETA ~2h.
Maya Alvarez: backfill started. I'm also exporting the raw GA4 CSV to: https://redwood.app/files/ga4-raw-launch-2026-04-10-12.csv
Rory Blake: when backfill done, ping me and I'll regenerate the 'week-over-week' snapshot and update the shareable slide link.
Dana Kim: thanks team. we'll meet briefly tomorrow 09:30 to confirm numbers before the KPI email goes out. :calendar:
